note: Dynamic block plan, revision 2 (2026-11-28), from the LA plan drawings (signing and striping, traffic signal and survey). Example dynamic blocks are masters kept as drawn; published blocks fold in only where base point and actions match. Striping detail blocks retired into line types (SSS-STRIPING-PLAN.lin).
